aerial_duels.note: Wyscout records a duel once for each player; the count is halved to give one per contest.

crosses.note: Wyscout counts open-play crosses only; the engine marks every kick that is a cross by its geometry, corners included. Not comparable as they stand.

ground_duels.note: Wyscout records a duel once for each player; the count is halved to give one per contest.

interceptions.note: Wyscout tags 'interception' on many events (any pass read and cut); the engine counts each interception as a choice. Not comparable.

stoppage_first_half_min.note: Wyscout: the last recorded event of the half, so a lower bound of the time played after the 45th.

stoppage_second_half_min.note: Wyscout: the last recorded event of the half, so a lower bound of the time played after the 45th.

source.data: Wyscout soccer-logs, Pappalardo, L. and Massucco, E. (2019), figshare, doi:10.6084/m9.figshare.c.4415000
source.made_by: tools/ds-reference (the raw data is not in the repository)
source.paper: Pappalardo, L., Cintia, P., Rossi, A. et al. (2019), A public data set of spatio-temporal match events in soccer competitions, Scientific Data 6, 236, doi:10.1038/s41597-019-0247-7
